# Data Integrity & Stock Synchronization Checklist: SPEC-2.1.1 Registro y Proceso de Ventas Esencial

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, completeness, clarity, and consistency of requirements governing atomic inventory reduction, transactional lifecycle states, immutability, and monetary calculations for bakery sales orders.

## 1. Requirement Completeness & Stock Synchronization

- [ ] CHK001 Are inventory validation requirements explicitly specified before allowing an order to confirm? [Completeness, Spec §3, Spec §4]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the atomic decrement of product inventory (`cantidad_disponible`) specified across multi-line orders? [Completeness, Spec §4, Principle II]
- [ ] CHK003 Are stock restoration requirements clearly documented when a confirmed order transitions to cancelled? [Completeness, Spec §2.1, Spec §4]
- [ ] CHK004 Does the specification define behavior when an order confirmation attempts to purchase more than available stock? [Completeness, Spec §3, Spec §8]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements documented for updating customer accumulated purchase metrics upon order confirmation? [Completeness, Spec §4, Spec §3.1.1]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the generation and linkage of an associated invoice record (`panaderia.factura`) specified as part of the confirmation transaction? [Completeness, Spec §2.1, Spec §4]

---

## 2. Mathematical Precision & Calculation Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is monetary rounding and decimal precision explicitly specified for line subtotal calculations? [Clarity, Spec §4]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the total order calculation formula unambiguously defined as the reactive sum of stored line subtotals? [Clarity, Spec §4]
- [ ] CHK009 Are boundary constraints for quantities (`cantidad > 0.0`) and unit prices (`precio_unitario >= 0.0`) quantified? [Clarity, Spec §4]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the trigger timing for sequential numbering assignment (`VEN-XXXX`) clearly distinguished between draft creation and confirmation? [Clarity, Spec §3, Spec §4]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the price lookup behavior documented when a cashier selects a product with a pre-configured sale price? [Clarity, Spec §4, Spec §5.1]

---

## 3. Transactional Invariants & Immutability Rules

- [ ] CHK012 Are read-only immutability requirements explicitly specified for all header and line fields once in confirmed state? [Consistency, Spec §3, Spec §5.3]
- [ ] CHK013 Does the specification define whether confirmed orders can be physically deleted or if deletion is strictly forbidden? [Consistency, Spec §3, Spec §5.3]
- [ ] CHK014 Are failure and rollback requirements documented if an error occurs during stock decrement or invoice generation? [Resilience, Gap, Principle II]
- [ ] CHK015 Are permissions and constraints defined regarding who is authorized to cancel an already-confirmed sale order? [Security, Spec §7]
- [ ] CHK016 Does the specification explicitly define whether an order can be returned from cancelled to draft for editing? [Lifecycle, Gap, Spec §2.1]

---

## 4. Acceptance Criteria Measurability & Verification Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 Can the counter sales total calculation in Acceptance Scenario 1 be objectively verified with discrete test fixtures? [Measurability, Spec §5.1]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the stock reduction criterion in Acceptance Scenario 2 quantified with exact numeric before/after values? [Measurability, Spec §5.2]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the field locking restriction in Acceptance Scenario 3 measurable with concrete UI and ORM assertions? [Measurability, Spec §5.3]
- [ ] CHK020 Are expected user-facing error messages for insufficient stock or invalid line amounts standardized in the specification? [Acceptance Criteria, Gap, Spec §4]

---

## 5. Edge Cases & Concurrency Scenarios

- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements specified for handling concurrent sales orders competing for the same inventory stock? [Edge Case, Spec §8]
- [ ] CHK022 Does the specification define validation behavior when attempting to confirm an order without any line items? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §4]
- [ ] CHK023 Is behavior documented if a product's list price changes while an existing draft order is pending confirmation? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §4]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for selling archived or inactive products within draft orders? [Edge Case, Spec §1.1.1, Gap]
